{"text":"ItemID: 1; Title: Anker USB C Cable, 2 Pack New Nylon USB C to USB C Cable (3.3ft 60W), USB 2.0 Type C Charging Cable for MacBook Pro 2020, iPad Pro 2020, iPad Air 4, Galaxy S20, Switch, Pixel, LG and More(Red); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent purchases use Micro USB or older Apple connectors, so I have no clear need for USB C to USB C cables.
ItemID: 2; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to add streaming to my television, though my 720p TV would not benefit from 4K.
ItemID: 3; Title: NETGEAR Orbi Whole Home Tri-Band Mesh WiFi 6 System (RBK653) Router with 2 Satellite Extenders, Coverage Up to 6,000 Square Feet, 40 Devices, AX3000 (Up to 3Gbps); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am shopping for practical device accessories and have no current need for a large mesh network.
ItemID: 4; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A voice assistant does not address the charging, storage, or mounting needs behind my recent purchases.
ItemID: 5; Title: Ring Charging Station for Quick Release Battery Packs; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have not purchased Ring battery devices, so this charger would have no clear use.
ItemID: 6; Title: AINOPE 2 Pack USB 3.0 Extension Cable Type A Male to Female Extension Cord 3.3FT Durable Braided Material Fast Data Transfer Compatible with USB Keyboard,Mouse,Flash Drive, Hard Drive,Printer-Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose these to make my USB card reader and other accessories easier to connect without reaching behind equipment.
ItemID: 7; Title: Echo Auto (1st gen) - Hands-free Alexa in your car with your phone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My car purchases focus on GPS mounting and cable access; I do not currently need an Alexa accessory.
ItemID: 8; Title: Samsung Galaxy Buds Plus, True Wireless Earbuds (Wireless Charging Case Included), White – US Version; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Earbuds are not a current priority given my recent focus on camera, power, and connection accessories.
ItemID: 9; Title: VCE Brush Wall Plate 2-Pack, UL Listed Cable Pass Through Insert for Wires, Single Gang Cable Access Strap, Wall Socket for HDTV, Home Theater Systems - Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Cable management is relevant, but I have no current wall-routing project that would justify these plates.
ItemID: 10; Title: Blink Whole Home Bundle | Video Doorbell System, Outdoor camera, and Mini camera | HD video, motion detection, Works with Alexa; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My camera accessories support photography; they do not indicate a current need for a home security system."}
